# Community Sale Help

> We run HOA and neighborhood community garage sales for boards and neighborhood groups anywhere in the US: signups, the map, signs, flyers and promotion. Run by Clark Richardson.

## Main pages
- [Home: HOA community garage sale, done for you](https://communitysalehelp.com/): what we handle, how it works, request form and FAQ.
